verdict.overall: Since Sunday the standout move is the wave of sharp rallies in AVGO, BE, ZETA, AMAT and TSLA (all up double digits) that have now run into opposing options walls just above price, while NVDA has dropped over 10% into earnings next week with pricey options layered on top. APP is the one name where resistance eased rather than built. Confidence in chasing the recent winners is falling as ceilings get added above them, while SPY stays the calmest, steady range play.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price jumped 11% to 397, but every expiry through early December now leans against further gains, with a floor near 350 and a new ceiling at 400 capping the rally.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: little changed overall. Price is up 7% to 171.58; this week's options oppose further gains (floor 150, ceiling 185), but next week turned supportive with the ceiling raised to 180.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price fell 11% to 166 with earnings landing 11-17, right after this week's expiry. Options stay neutral but are pricey, and trading today is unusually busy versus the magnet, so that level may not hold.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price surged 20% to 37.27, but the next two weeks now oppose further upside, with a ceiling at 40 and 39 capping the move despite the strong trend.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: little changed in rating, still neutral, but price jumped 14.5% to 380.95 and the floor rose to 365, right under price. Options are notably pricey, and earnings land today, adding risk.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: weaker. Price rallied 24% to 364.36 and now every expiry through December opposes further gains, with the floor jumping to 320. Earnings fall on 12-09, inside this window, adding extra risk.
tickers.GOOGL: Since Sunday: weaker. Price edged up 4.9% to 298.70, but this week and the 12-04 expiry flipped to opposing, with a ceiling stuck around 300 capping upside both times.
tickers.APP: Since Sunday: stronger. Price is little changed near 393.68, but three of the four expiries flipped from opposing to neutral, with ceilings raised well above price (435, 450), suggesting less built-in resistance now.
tickers.BE: Since Sunday: weaker. Price jumped 16.6% to 201.93, but this week's options flipped to opposing with a ceiling raised to 220. Trading today is unusually busy at the magnet level, so it may be less reliable short-term.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed. Price is up 3% to 757, and every expiry stays neutral with a steady range (nearest week floor £107.58, magnet £109.46, ceiling £112.06). Today's trading is unusually busy versus the magnet, so that level carries less weight right now.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: weaker. Price rose 4.9% to 688, but this week's options flipped to opposing with the ceiling raised to 710 (roughly £80.04 for ISUS, which only partly tracks Nasdaq). Trading today is also unusually busy at the magnet level, adding noise.
